d: Chestnut brown hair with straight bangs and two long low-hanging side locks is partially covered by a black ushanka with three gold stars on the front. The eyes are a vivid orange-red with a wide, cheerful expression, set on a face with the apparent age of a young child. A petite build is dressed in a white tunic with brown buckles and red trim, worn under a light blue cape and paired with a black skirt and black fingerless gloves. Signature details include a red marking centered on the forehead and a white scarf wrapped around the neck.
